history.summary: A local Vaishnava temple dedicated to Lord Krishna reported at Kakching Khunou. No independent web source documents this temple — the generic name has no verifiable web footprint and identity is UNCERTAIN/PROVISIONAL (thin placeholder). It is not the well-documented Krishna Chandra temple at Kakching Bazar or the Shri Krishna Temple of Imphal; those are distinct, documented shrines. Nothing is known of its founding date, size, or managing body. FLAG: the CSV 'state' column wrongly holds the town name (Kakching Khunou); the shrine is in MANIPUR. FLAG: media is empty — no verified image of this shrine exists online. Opening hours and festivals are unverified (verify on site).

name: Krishna Temple
town_description: Kakching Khunou is a town in Kakching district, Manipur, about 44 km southeast of Imphal. It lies in the heart of Manipur's garden belt, close to the Kakching Garden tourist site, and is a predominantly Meitei locality where Vaishnavite Hindu temples sit alongside indigenous Sanamahism traditions.

travel.airport: Bir Tikendrajit International Airport, Imphal (~44 km)
travel.railway: Nearest major railhead is Dimapur (Nagaland), ~200 km; the nearest in-state station is Jiribam.
travel.road: Kakching Khunou lies on the Kakching road network off NH-102 (Imphal-Moreh highway), about 44 km from Imphal; buses and shared taxis run from Imphal and Kakching town.
